resource.name: aws_route53_vpc_association_authorization
resource.description: Authorizes a VPC in a different account to be associated with a local Route53 Hosted Zone.
resource.llm_summary: "Manages the authorization process for associating a VPC from a different AWS account with a local Route53 Hosted Zone, enabling cross-account DNS management and integration. Commonly used for multi-account architectures, hybrid cloud setups, or shared services environments where DNS resolution needs to span multiple VPCs. Supports configurations for secure cross-account access, facilitating scalable and centralized DNS management across isolated AWS accounts."

examples.title: Basic Usage
examples.llm_summary: This example demonstrates how to configure an `aws_route53_vpc_association_authorization` resource to authorize and associate an alternate VPC with a private Route 53 hosted zone. It showcases key configurations such as using multiple AWS providers, managing VPC associations with lifecycle rules, and creating cross-account or cross-region VPC associations for DNS resolution.

arguments.name: id
arguments.llm_summary: The `id` argument in the `aws_route53_vpc_association_authorization` resource represents the unique identifier for the association authorization between a Route 53 hosted zone and a VPC. While optional, it is typically used to reference or manage the specific authorization instance, enabling users to track or interact with the resource programmatically in Terraform configurations.

arguments.name: vpc_id
arguments.description: (Required) The VPC to authorize for association with the private hosted zone.
arguments.llm_summary: The `vpc_id` argument specifies the unique identifier of the VPC that is authorized for association with a private Route 53 hosted zone. By setting this required parameter, users enable the VPC to access and utilize DNS records within the private hosted zone, facilitating secure and controlled DNS resolution for resources in the specified VPC.

arguments.name: vpc_region
arguments.description: (Optional) The VPC's region. Defaults to the region of the AWS provider.
arguments.llm_summary: The `vpc_region` argument in the `aws_route53_vpc_association_authorization` resource allows users to specify the AWS region of the VPC being authorized for association with a private Route 53 hosted zone. By setting this argument, users can control cross-region VPC associations, enabling multi-region DNS configurations or ensuring the VPC resides in a specific region if different from the default AWS provider region.

arguments.name: zone_id
arguments.description: (Required) The ID of the private hosted zone that you want to authorize associating a VPC with.
arguments.llm_summary: The `zone_id` argument specifies the unique identifier of a private hosted zone in Route 53, enabling the authorization of VPC associations with that zone. By defining this required parameter, users ensure the targeted private hosted zone is explicitly identified for VPC association authorization, facilitating controlled access and integration between Route 53 DNS configurations and VPCs.
